items.markdown:
UK passport holders can stay in Thailand for **60 days** without a visa under the tourist exemption scheme, which can be extended locally.[](https://www.kayak.co.uk/news/visa-for-thailand/) [[1]](https://www.kayak.co.uk/news/visa-for-thailand/)

Visa Exemption and Extensions

- **Initial stay:** 60 days on arrival without needing to apply for a visa beforehand.
- **Extension:** You can apply to extend this stay for another **30 days** at a local Thai immigration office for a fee, making a total of 90 days.
- **Digital Arrival Card:** You must complete the online Thailand Digital Arrival Card within 3 days before you arrive.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements) [[1]](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements)[[2]](https://cibtvisas.co.uk/thailand-visa)[[3]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information)[[4]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa)

Longer Stays and Visas

- **Tourist Visa:** You can apply online beforehand via the Official Thai E-Visa Website for a pre-arranged tourist visa if you plan a longer or specific type of trip.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information) [[1]](https://www.thaiembassy.com/thailand-visa/thailand-tourist-visa)
- **Overstaying:** Staying past your permitted stamp results in a fine of 500 Thai Baht per day (up to 20,000 Baht), potential detention, and travel bans.[](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/thailand/entry-requirements)
